Pricing & Payment, No Surprises, Just Straight Talk

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we like to keep things real. No confusing fine print. No hidden traps. Just honest pricing, flexible options, and full transparency, because that's how partnerships work.

1. Location-Based Perks

Prices may vary based on where you're tuning in from. Why? Because we believe in smart, region-based plans that work better for you. We may use your location or payment method to match you with the right plan. Discovered using a plan that isn't appropriate for your area? No stress, we'll adjust it fairly and let you know.

2. When Prices Shift, You'll Know First

You should never be taken by surprise, in our opinion. If we ever update your subscription price, we'll give you at least 21 days' notice, no sneaky charges, no silent changes. There will always be time for you to make the best decision.

3. Choose How You Pay

We take credit cards and PayPal, among other payment methods. If your payment provider adds a handling fee, that's on their side (not ours). We don't like hidden charges either, so we recommend checking with your bank if you're unsure.

4. Your Payment Info Stays Safe

Do you have a new card, or have you changed your billing address? Just update your info in your account. Once you're subscribed, billing happens automatically each period but you're always in control. Cancel anytime. As long as it makes you feel comfortable, stay.

5. Powered by Trusted Payment Systems

We don't handle payments directly. Instead, we use reliable outside processors to securely manage transactions. Your billing details are stored safely with them, and yes they follow strict rules to protect your privacy.

6. Currency Stuff You Should Know

Our prices are listed in US dollars (or euros in the EU), but your bank might convert the payment to your local currency, and might charge a fee for it. We don't control those charges, so if anything looks off, it's best to check with your bank.
